_comment: Deploy-time-baked default render + offline/rate-limit safety net. No release is published yet, so every URL points at the GitHub /releases/latest web alias (which 302s to the newest release once one exists, and is a benign landing page until then) and the version is the placeholder 'alpha'. The CI step in .github/workflows/release.yml overwrites this file with real per-asset browser_download_urls + the real tag the first time a v* tag publishes; download.js then upgrades it live at runtime via the GitHub REST API. download.js MUST tolerate this placeholder gracefully (it treats any URL containing '/releases/latest' as 'not yet a real asset' and falls through to the <details> floor for that target).
